text:
Anita R.: quick heads-up — PR #4829 is ready for security eyes. Adds an on‑prem KMS proxy sidecar + a new egress route to allow requests to customer KMS. planning to merge into release/1.4 on Tue if no blockers. can someone take a quick look for secrets/egress issues?

Samir: @Anita R. pinging sec reviewers. main things to check: 1) any credentials in code or tests, 2) service account scopes, 3) logs that might contain KMS tokens.

Anita R.: thanks. TL;DR of changes: new env var KMS_ENDPOINT, a small proxy container in sidecar, and a firewall rule in infra/terraform that opens outbound to customer-kms.example.com:443. No plaintext keys added; proxy uses workload identity.

Jess: quick skim — code looks tidy but noticed a test fixture that sets KMS_ENDPOINT to a local value in test/fixtures/kms.json — can you paste that snippet?

Anita R.: here it is: 
```
# test/fixtures/kms.json
{"KMS_ENDPOINT": "http://localhost:8080", "KMS_TOKEN": "test-token-123"}
```
this fixture is only used by unit tests, not packaged.

SecurityBot: automated-secret-scan: found 1 secret-like pattern in test/fixtures/kms.json -> KMS_TOKEN. Recommendation: replace with test stub or env-based injection. Status: advisory. Link: https://scans.internal/reports/4829 (scan id s-4829). :mag:

Mike: flagging the infra change — the terraform addition is in modules/network/egress.tf. It adds a cidr/host rule for customer-kms.example.com which resolves to a dynamic IP set. Need to ensure we pin to FQDNs handled by our egress gateway, not open to 0.0.0.0/0.

Olivia: also confirm the sidecar doesn't log the token. quick grep shows proxy logs at info level printing request metadata — can we drop any headers in logs?

Anita R.: yes — proxy already redacts Authorization header but we didn't redact X-KMS-Request-Id. I'll add a patch to redact headers and remove KMS_TOKEN from test fixtures.

Samir: thanks. two asks before LGTM: 1) remove secret from fixtures and switch tests to secretless stub, 2) add terraform comment that egress is strictly to customer's managed FQDN and route through our egress gateway or VPC peering. If both done, sec LGTM.

Jess: +1 on tests. also please add a short note in PR description about why workload identity is safe here, and link to the threat model.

Anita R.: will do. ETA for updates: I'll push a small commit in ~2 hours and ping back. If anyone wants to pre-review the redaction patch I'll post the diff here. :pray:

SecurityBot: deploy-checker: infra plan contains new egress rule; flagged for manual review due to outbound to third-party KMS. Please confirm justification in PR comments.

Mike: scheduling note — release/1.4 freeze is tomorrow 17:00 UTC. If we want to merge, we need final approval by 15:00 UTC to allow smoke tests.

Olivia: if Anita posts the redaction commit and test cleanup within 2 hours I can re-scan and give final OK.

Anita R.: update pushed: removed KMS_TOKEN from fixtures, replaced with stub helper; proxy now redacts X-KMS-Request-Id and Authorization. PR comment updated with workload identity rationale and threat model link: https://wiki.internal/threats/kms-proxy. pinging for re-review.

Samir: re-reviewing now. running quick grep and infra check.

Jess: verified tests no longer contain tokens. :thumbsup:

SecurityBot: automated-secret-scan: no secret-like patterns detected in changed files.

Mike: infra note satisfied if egress routes through egress-gateway and we pin allowed FQDNs in the gateway allowlist. can infra confirm?

Anita R.: infra confirmed via comment from @olivia earlier — gateway allowlist updated in a separate PR; cross-ref added.

Olivia: confirmed. LGTM from infra side.

Samir: OK from sec after quick manual check. leaving final approval to @Jess for prod-readiness.

Jess: giving final approval. please merge before freeze cutoff. :rocket:

Anita R.: merged at 4412346278 — thanks all!
